result:
Round 281 is implemented and ready for C. All of A's own checks passed; nothing was committed or pushed.

**What changed** (only the files B granted):
- **Code:** the 5 perf harness files. My changes are byte-identical to B's sketch. A failed demo sound now stops a perf pass at load with a named error, instead of a 90 s or 15 s timeout. The three copies of the library-ready wait are now one shared `waitForLibraryReady`. The `interact.harness.click-live` row now records `clipTrackId` and `emptyLaneTrackId`. The lane error can no longer say "lane null".
- **Docs:** new doc 210, plus the granted sections of docs 168, 169, 175, 208 and 209.
- No app code, budgets, config, `.claude` or protected files were touched. The frozen-file check (`sha256sum -c`) is rc 0.

**Results (all actually run):**
- **Typecheck and lint:** typecheck rc 0. Lint rc 0, with 205 warnings that were already there.
- **Perf run, alone:** 3 passed in 13.4 min (PERF-1b-i 5.1 min, PERF-1b-ii 1.1 min, PERF-1a 7.0 min).
- **Equivalence against C's earlier results:** 0 problems for all three specs. One line in PERF-1b-ii fell within the named tolerance (`res.export.1.peak-backing-delta-mib` 65 → 65.1), which the task allows.
- **Lane ids:** 6 of 6 samples show `music` → `stems` after the three old keys, so the "empty Stems lane" notes stay true.
- **Mutants:** every one gave its expected signal.

  | Mutant | Result |
  |---|---|
  | Selected sound fails | every pass aborts at load with the exact named error; the whole run took 9.2 s (it took 90 s per pass before this change) |
  | Another sound fails | every pass aborts at load; the library-ready wait caught it in all 6 passes |
  | Library-ready failure check disabled | every pass aborts with the status-wait message, which proves that second check works |
  | Lane guard removed | the type check fails with TS2322 on the `clipTrackId` line |

- **Claims check:** identical to B's expected output, except K1. On an archive copy that line prints `(archive)` because it is not a git repo; in the repo, HEAD is `145f6c1`. C will see the same.

**Code review:** the reviewer scored it 9/10 with no Critical, High or Medium findings.
- I fixed two inaccurate doc statements: doc 210 gave the wrong reason for passing the pattern's `.source`, and doc 175 said "both load waits" when PERF-1b-ii has only one.
- I did not change the code for two Low findings, because any edit would invalidate the equivalence and mutant evidence. I recorded them for B as A-R281-REVIEW-SETTLED-GROUP (how the combined pattern is grouped) and A-R281-REVIEW-STATUS-REREAD (a small race when the status is read a second time).
- Architecture note for B and root: keep the readiness checks in the shared page helper. The growing pattern builders in `app-labels.ts` are already tracked as GATE279-ARCH-COPY-STRINGS.

**Not run by me:** the browser half of the lane-id check (confirming which lane is empty on `/studio-lab`) and the no-sign-in auth check are C's browser checks. The full test suite, build, `verify` and the e2e smoke test belong to the root gate. Two items stay open: PERF-1b-ii can still measure when a non-selected sound fails (B-R281-RESOURCES-READY-FAILED), and ROOT-REQ-PERF-TIMEOUT (PERF-1a took 7.0 min, 47 % of its 15 min limit).

The report is `tmp/studio-real-loop/a-round-281.md`; evidence is in `tmp/studio-real-loop/a-round-281/`.
